2014_spells.aura-of-vitality.description: Healing energy radiates from you in an aura with a radius of 30 feet. Until the spell ends, the aura moves with you, centered on you. You can use a bonus action to cause one creature in the aura (including you) to regain 2d6 hit points.
2014_spells.aura-of-vitality.effectSumma: Restore 2d6 HP to a creature you touch
2014_spells.aura-of-vitality.fullDescrip: Using 1 bonus action, you can use a bonus action to cause one creature in the aura (including you) to regain 2d6 hit points. Healing energy radiates from you in an aura with a radius of 30 feet; Until the spell ends, the aura moves with you, centered on you. Until the spell ends, the aura moves with you, centered on you; you must concentrate, and the effect ends if your concentration ends.
